artifacts.title: Class 65-9WA Presentation Lighter
artifacts.description: Named 1965 Fort Wolters Class 65-9WA presentation lighter with external class and later-service context.
artifacts.condition_summary: Exterior condition and mechanical movement described in the evidence packet; no current spark or operation claim is made.

metadata.front_markings: Class 65-9WA and Hughes World Leader marking
metadata.operation_claim: No operation claim; no flint installed and not cleaned, fueled, or serviced for operation.
metadata.historical_significance: Named Fort Wolters presentation lighter with related VHPA class evidence and later Tropic Lightning News service-context evidence.

physical_object_evidence: Reverse inscription to WOC Arthur P. Lancy Jr.
PARK Lighter / Made in U.S.A. base stamp
vhpa_class_evidence: VHPA WOC Class Pictures Archive index
VHPA Class 65-9W roster/name-list image with Lancy on the roster
later_service_evidence: Tropic Lightning News, Vol. 2 No. 13, April 3, 1967
Page 2, Decorated section, Air Medal subsection
Lists WO Arthur P. Lancy, Co. B, 25th Avn. Bn.
claim_boundaries: No claim that the lighter was carried in Vietnam
No claim that the lighter was used in combat
No claim that the Air Medal listing proves use or carry of this lighter
No claim that the A in 65-9WA means Alpha
No claim that Hughes marking proves official issue
